The following is a video clip taken at the 25th anniversary commemoration ceremony of the September 11 attacks held at the Pentagon on Friday (September 11), in which US President Trump can be seen.

以下是幾張照片：

White House spokesperson Davis Ingle said in a statement to HuffPost: "President Trump solemnly listened and mourned the victims who tragically lost their lives that day, as well as the brave rescue workers. Anyone absurdly claiming that the president was dozing off is lying."
